title: Manosphere / Far-Right Anti-Zionist Cluster on X
question: Which far-right, manosphere, and America First accounts pivoted into high-engagement anti-Israel / anti-Zionist content after October 2023, how do they connect to each other and to the seed five, and what claims do they actually post in the current window (2026-07-27 to 2026-08-26)?
scope: Platform: X public posts with light public-web corroboration. T0 current behavior 2026-07-27 to 2026-08-26; T1 post-Oct 7 growth 2023-10-01 to 2024-06-30; T2 pre-pivot 2023-01-01 to 2023-09-30; T3 Detroit AFPAC-replacement node 2024-06-01 to 2024-07-15. Languages: English primary; Greek/Danish only if present on Loupis. Geography: US-centric manosphere/America First audience plus Danish/Greek Loupis persona. Exclusion: do not dump every Free Palestine user; no private contact or family data.
publicInterestBasis: Named accounts in this cluster reach hundreds of thousands to more than a million followers and currently move claims about Israel, Jews, Gaza, and the Charlie Kirk killing into manosphere and America First audiences. Distinguishing named persons, backups, lookalikes, and anonymous clip farms, and testing whether a coordinated cluster exists, bears on public understanding of a high-reach information environment.
confidence: **Confidence: high on pivot (Loupis/Shields/CensoredMen), high on identities, high on Detroit attendance set, high on the schism finding; low on Truthtellerftm operator.**

bottomLine.text: **H1 pivot is proven with primary data** for three test accounts: Loupis's Sep-2023 feed was pure vaccine-skepticism (incl. a 1.84M-view item); Shields's was trans-mockery; CensoredMen's was pure Tate manosphere (one 13.6M-view item). Their T0 output is now Israel/Jews-centric (Loupis, Shields) or dormant (CensoredMen). ADL independently measured **>1070% combined engagement growth** for Hinkle+Gage+Shields+Parker+CensoredMen in the six months after Oct 7.

bottomLine.text: **H3 holds only for brands, never persons:** Loupis = licensed Danish physician (register 0BYZW); Gage's rename is documented (Angelo John Gage → Lucas Gage, 2022); every named handle is long-running. The genuinely anonymous node is `@CensoredMen` (1.00M followers, **dormant since 2024-11-17** — verified via API), plus show-brand `@ShieldsClips` and UNRESOLVED `@Truthtellerftm`.

**The headline structural finding is a schism, not a cell.** In June 2026 Lucas Gage told a Jewish podcast the Kirk-conspiracy line was his "final straw" out of antisemitic activism; Stew Peters (alongside Shields) answered that the movement would be better if Gage "had never existed." T0 shows the split live: Gage politely debates genocide-law with pro-Israel lawyers while dropping raw asides ("The Jews control Israel"), Loupis QT'd that Gage "did a collab with this demon," Ian Carroll posts "None of these people are on the same team," and Myron Gaines barely posts Israel at all.

bottomLine.text: **T0 claims actually posted** (verbatim, video-unverified where clips): Shields amplified an explicit Holocaust-hoax post ("carefully cultivated, elaborate hoax") framed as a free-speech grievance; posted "Even the best of the goyim shall be killed" as a standalone caption; "Every paid influencer supports Israel…"; Fuentes: "the Zionists got Trump to cover up the Epstein files…" (1.03M); Parker: Kirk death as "Two Birds, With One She[kel]" dual operation; Stew: TPUSA "installed two Jews from Israel as treasurer."

**Detroit (T3) attendance confirmed** for Fuentes, Shields, Sneako, David Duke, Sam Parker; **Gage attended per ADL** (upgrading prior-run uncertainty); Loupis and Sulaiman Ahmed engaged remotely. Venue canceled twice amid fraud allegations; megaphone rally praised Henry Ford.

**Two corrections to the archived shallow run:** tweet `2088343735754981527` does **not** say "Charlie Kirk was killed by Israel" (real text: "I like Andrew Wilson but how telling is it that only Turning…"); Stew's Shmuley caption actually begins "RABBI SHMULEY: 'The Jewish people must be feared…'". Both corrected against live API text.
**Kirk-responsible-Israel claims remain refuted** as fact (court record; case-01 sources) while remaining a live cluster narrative — except in Gage's lane, which publicly rejects them.

limitations: Mirror layer lacks absolute dates/IDs; engagement counter order presumed; video contents unverified; T0 window effectively ~last 8 days for most handles despite nominal 30-day scope; Gage T2 empty on current handle (index gap); single-source block-fee claim; right-of-reply outstanding. Not cleared for publication without editorial/legal review.

Two-layer design (free mirrors for breadth; paid relay for precision) with all raw pulls hashed under `evidence/api/`. Entity resolution before any harvesting; lookalikes resolved but excluded from exhibits. Prior-run exhibit IDs treated as pointers and independently re-verified — two caption misquotes caught and corrected (claim_08). T2 pivots tested with date-bounded API searches rather than asserted. Coordination language follows evidence classes; the schism finding is itself the strongest anti-coordination evidence.
unknowns: CensoredMen operator + reason for dormancy (still 1M followers).
Whether @DrLoupis main is throttled post-Musk-row (his own claim) or strategically quiet.
Truthtellerftm operator (followings show CGTN Europe / IRGC-Iran-affairs interests; insufficient for attribution).
Video-caption fidelity for Mizrachi/Spectre/Shmuley/"goyim" clips (playback unavailable).
Full T0 30-day window per handle via API (~$3–5) once deeper budget approved.

Right-of-reply to named persons not sought this run. **Disconfirming ledger:** Carroll's statement, Myron's incidental share, Woods's internal-debunk focus, CensoredMen dormancy, and the documented Gage schism all cut against a single coordinated cell; shared audience + Detroit + common enemies remain sufficient only for "neighborhood with frictions."

**Disconfirming ledger:** Carroll's statement, Myron's incidental share, Woods's internal-debunk focus, CensoredMen dormancy, and the documented Gage schism all cut against a single coordinated cell; shared audience + Detroit + common enemies remain sufficient only for "neighborhood with frictions."
contradictions: **Gage rejects the cluster's Kirk line** (JTA; T0 behavior) while Shields/Sneako/Stew/Parker push it — status: refuted-as-fact per court reporting, active-as-narrative.
**Carroll's "not on the same team"** statement against coordination readings.
**Loupis split:** pro-Palestine abroad + anti-Muslim-immigration at home (own words, Aug 10).
**Loupis hack disclaimer** (Aug 10, main): telegram scam warning — context for impersonation noise, not a denial of her political output.
**Third-party ops claim:** chrisbrunet RT on ShieldsClips asserts Shields' main is "clearly a team of people." Unverified; logged as lead only.
**Lookalikes:** exist but produced none of the examined exhibits.
**Community Notes:** none surfaced in sampled threads; absence ≠ proof of absence.
**Fuentes vs Hinkle:** no T0 contact found; tension remains a group-01 lead.
